description:
Start paid Runway Ruby SDR-to-HDR conversion (POST /api/v1/videos/hdr/generations, model="ruby").

First call estimate_video_hdr with the same owned SDR video_url (<= 30 s, < 4096 px per side) and
output_format (hdr10, hlg, hdr_prores with optional prores_profile 422 / "422 HQ" / 4444,
hdr_exr_sequence, hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_1_3, or hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_2_0). Supports optional
max_cost_rub and webhook_url. Returns a job ID; read get_video.

max_cost_rub.description: Optional maximum approved price in RUB from /videos/hdr/estimate.
max_cost_rub.title: Max Cost Rub

output_format.description: HDR output format: hdr10, hlg, hdr_prores, hdr_exr_sequence, hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_1_3, or hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_2_0.
output_format.title: Output Format

prores_profile.description: ProRes profile when output_format='hdr_prores' ('422', '422 HQ', or '4444').
prores_profile.title: Prores Profile

video_url.description: Owned Arckep storage key or URL of an SDR source video (<=30 s, <4096 px per side, <=200 MB).
video_url.title: Video Url

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook URL notified when the job finishes.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

name: create_video_hdr
